svg.title: Sheets with dots W, F, S, U and the tree branches they feed
svg.desc: Left: one floor of the set, the 2nd floor plan, with four sheet copies: a201 2nd with dot W, s201 2nd with dot F, s201 2nd sw with dot S, a3011 u with dot U. Right: the tree of one building: walls, sqfts, openings from W; framing with joists, beams, headers, posts, details from F; shear walls with shear and holdowns from S; units from U. Lines in the dot colour connect sheet to branch.
svg.text: Один этаж, четыре листа с точками, четыре ветки дерева
W: Line, Count в walls; Area в sqfts; Openings в openings.
F: Count в framing; Line в details; Area в joists; Beam в beams.
Рисуешь на листе - позиция сама уходит в ветку его точки.
Имя с eve, rake, gable, prpt, trussheel уходит в свою папку с любого листа, кроме U.
